senses.gloss: (v. גדד I) to lop off, stump.—Part. pass. גָּדוּם, f. גְּדוּמָה.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 62b">Zeb. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>אמה ג׳</he> (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:4:4">Y. Yoma IV, 41ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>גְּמוּדָה</he>) a reduced cubit, v. <cite ref="A01989"><he>אַמָּה</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12">Gen. R. s. 12</cite> <he>אמה ג׳</he>, read <cite ref="C01298"><he>גְּרוּמָה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="C01349"><he>גָּרַם</he></cite>.] <cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 5:4">Tosef. Bekh. V, 4</cite> <he>אצבעותיו גְּדוּמוֹת</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>גרומות</he>) with stump-like fingers.
<cite ref="Taanit 21a:8">Taan. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>ידי … יִתְגַּדְּמוּ</he> may my hands … be stumped (through sickness).
